decisions.label: Challenge pack: adults per kind
decisions.note: How many adults of each kind on the island's roster guard the challenge circle (Ed, 2026-11-03: "one adult and one youth of every creature kind on the island"). 0 leaves only youths. A new night: it reloads.

decisions.label: Challenge pack: youths per kind
decisions.note: How many youths of each kind on the island's roster guard the challenge circle (Ed, 2026-11-03: "one adult and one youth of every creature kind on the island"). A new night: it reloads.

decisions.label: Challenge circle radius (m)
decisions.note: The challenge area's stone floor circle (Ed, 2026-11-03: "a large stone floor circle (like the legend circle)"; on #1725, three times wider: 36 m), its columns round its edge (their count is the knob challenge.columns, 30). A legend's circle is about 9 m. A new map: it reloads.

decisions.label: Challenge clearing margin (m)
decisions.note: How far past the challenge circle's edge the woods are cleared (Ed, 2026-11-03, on #1725: "trees should come close to the circle's edge"). A new map: it reloads.
